english.title: Drive / move / cause to remain at rest a passenger carrying vehicle in right hand lane of a motorway

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Motorways Traffic England and Wales Regulations 1982

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(2) of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 12(3) and (4) for exceptions.
(ii) See regulation 12(5) for meaning of "passenger vehicle" and "maximum laden weight".
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) This regulation applies to ALL passenger vehicles constructed or adapted to carry more than eight seated passengers and the gross vehicle weight exceeds 3500kg.
